race.comment: POINT OF LUCK (9) was solid over much further last time when settling well back but kept coming. Won only try course and distance and will be storming home late. SIDE SHOW (7) missed the placings two runs back then settled well back last start when 9 lengths away in tenth over 1685m at Bunbury. Won't find this as tough so he is one of the main contenders. L'IL CAPRI (3) missed the placings two runs back then didn't feature last start when 15 lengths away in 12th over 2200m at Belmont Park. Rates highly on the runs prior. OBSCENTINO (2) showed early speed from an outside draw last time and led for much of the way before weakening to finish eighth in the same race as POINT OF LUCK. Looks well placed here and expected to give a sight.
